skills.description: Review guidance for early acknowledgements, expired leases, messages that block a partition, ordering assumptions, and producers that overwhelm consumers.
install_when: work or data crosses a broker, queue, stream, or pub-sub system.

skills.name: gd-realtime-web
skills.description: Checks for reconnect storms, permissions that expire while connections stay open, unbounded buffers, and clients unable to recover from missed or reordered messages.
install_when: the project uses WebSockets, server-sent events, long polling, or similar live client connections.

skills.name: gd-data-privacy
skills.description: Guidance on data collected without a defined purpose, deletion that misses downstream copies, excessive retention, and personal information leaking through logs.
install_when: the project collects, derives, stores, shares, exports, retains, or deletes personal or sensitive data.

skills.name: gd-web-accessibility
skills.description: Checks for lost keyboard focus, color-only meaning, unannounced updates, misleading control semantics, and tasks that become unusable when text is enlarged.
install_when: the project includes user-facing web interfaces or rendered web content.

skills.name: gd-dependency-supply-chain
skills.description: Review guidance for lookalike packages, transitive dependency drift, install scripts with excessive access, and build tools downloading undeclared inputs.
install_when: the project uses third-party dependencies, generated code, build packages, images, or promoted artifacts.

skills.name: gd-schema-evolution
skills.description: Checks for old and new code that cannot coexist, backfills that block traffic, retained data that new code cannot read, and rollback requiring discarded information.
install_when: the project has persistent, message, API, file, or configuration schemas that can evolve.

skills.name: gd-windows
skills.description: Guidance on ACLs checked under the wrong identity, registry differences across architectures, COM apartment violations, and installers that cannot recover from partial updates.
install_when: software depends on Windows desktop or server behavior.

skills.name: gd-android
skills.description: Checks for process-death assumptions, unintentionally exported components, unsafe pending intents or WebView bridges, and background work that cannot run as planned.
install_when: software targets Android devices.

skills.name: gd-ios
skills.description: Review guidance for limited background time, permission denial with no usable fallback, weak protection of sensitive files, and overly broad keychain sharing.
install_when: software targets Apple mobile devices.

skills.name: gd-macos
skills.description: Checks for signing and sandbox settings that fail together, stale file-access bookmarks, unhandled privacy denials, and updates that lose user state.
install_when: software targets macOS.

skills.name: gd-aws-ecs
skills.description: Guidance on load-balancer draining shorter than shutdown, task and execution roles granting the wrong access, stale secrets, and rollbacks that ignore data changes.
install_when: the project deploys or operates workloads with Amazon ECS, Fargate, or ECS on EC2.

skills.name: gd-grpc-protobuf
skills.description: Checks for reused field numbers, lost unknown fields, missing deadline propagation, unsafe retries, and streams without backpressure.
install_when: services communicate through gRPC or protobuf contracts.

skills.name: gd-apache-http-server
skills.description: Review guidance for directives in the wrong context, rewrite loops, untrusted forwarded identity, thread-unsafe module combinations, and stale processes after reload.
install_when: the project serves or routes traffic through Apache HTTP Server, or Apache behavior constrains a supported environment.
